title: CLAUDE CODE CAN NOW HAND WORK BETWEEN SESSIONS—**WITHOUT MAKING DEVELOPERS EXPLAIN EVERYTHING AGAIN*
description:
Claude Code can now pass work directly between separate sessions instead of making developers restate the task. A session sends a summary—not the full conversation history or project files—and the receiving session can pick up mid-task. The feature creates a cleaner handoff workflow for long builds, debugging, and context-heavy work. The useful task state travels between sessions while the underlying history and files do not.

Source: ClaudeDevs on X
